name: Allowance or charge identification code
description: Code specifying the identification of an allowance or charge.

values.name: Handling commission
values.description: Handling commission Fee for the processing of documentary credit, collection and payment which are charged to the customer.

values.name: Amendment commission
values.description: Amendment commission Fee for amendments in documentary credit and collection business (not extensions and increases of documentary credits).

values.name: Acceptance commission
values.description: Acceptance commission Fee for the acceptance of draft in documentary credit and collection business which are drawn on us (also to be seen as a kind of 'guarantee commission').

values.name: Commission for obtaining acceptance
values.description: Commission for obtaining acceptance Fee for obtaining an acceptance under collections on the basis of 'documents against acceptance'.

values.name: Commission on delivery
values.description: Commission on delivery Fee for delivery of documents without corresponding payment.

values.name: Advising commission
values.description: Advising commission Fee for advising documentary credits (charged also in case of confirmed credits).

values.name: Confirmation commission
values.description: Confirmation commission Fee for confirmation of credit.

values.name: Deferred payment commission
values.description: Deferred payment commission Fee for the deferred payment period under documentary credits confirmed by bank. This fee are charges for the period from presentation of the document until due date of payment.

values.name: Commission for taking up documents
values.description: Commission for taking up documents Fee charged to the foreign bank for the processing of documentary credit.

values.name: Opening commission
values.description: Opening commission Fee for opening revocable documentary credit.

values.name: Fee for payment under reserve
values.description: Fee for payment under reserve Fee charged to the customer for discrepancies in credit documents in the case of which the bank have to stipulate payment under reserve.

values.name: Discrepancy fee
values.description: Discrepancy fee Fee charged to the foreign bank for discrepancies in credit documents.

values.name: Domicilation commission
values.description: Domicilation commission Fee for the domicilation of bills with the bank.

values.name: Commission for release of goods
values.description: Commission for release of goods Commission for the release of goods sent to the bank.

values.name: Collection commission
values.description: Collection commission Fee for settling collections on the basis of 'documents against payments'.

values.name: Negotiation commission
values.description: Negotiation commission Fee for the purchase of documents under sight credit for the first ten days.

values.name: Return commission
values.description: Return commission Fee for cheques, bills and collections returned unpaid and/or recalled.

values.name: B/L splitting charges
values.description: B/L splitting charges Fee for the splitting of bills of lading.

values.name: Trust commission
values.description: Trust commission Fee for the handling on a fiduciary basis of imported goods that have been warehoused.

values.name: Transfer commission
values.description: Transfer commission Fee for the transfer of transferable documentary credits.

values.name: Commission for opening irrevocable documentary credits
values.description: Commission for opening irrevocable documentary credits Fee for opening irrevocable documentary credits. This fee is a kind of 'Guarantee commission' as compensation for the commitment into which the bank have entered on the customers behalf; similar to confirmation commission, acceptance commission.

values.name: Pre-advice commission
values.description: Pre-advice commission Fee for the pre-advice of a documentary credit.

values.name: Supervisory commission
values.description: Supervisory commission Fee for the supervising unconfirmed documentary credits with a deferred payment period.

values.name: Model charges
values.description: Model charges Fee for decoding telex messages.

values.name: Risk commission

values.name: Guarantee commission
